entries.zh: 把含糊文案换成直接的行动号召后，落地页转化率上升了。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，客户留存，顾客维系，留客率相关工作

entries.zh: 续约团队的奖金与客户留存挂钩，而非新客户获取。

entries.spelling: D, R, I, P, hyphen, C, A, M, P, A, I, G, N

entries.zh: 试用用户会进入为期七天的滴灌活动，突出介绍产品核心功能。

entries.spelling: S, A, L, E, S, hyphen, F, U, N, N, E, L
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，销售漏斗，转化漏斗，销售管道阶段模型

entries.zh: 因太多线索卡在销售漏斗中段，我们重新设计了演示环节。

entries.spelling: S, E, R, V, I, C, E, hyphen, A, G, R, E, E, M, E, N, T
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，服务协议，服务合同，服务条款协议
entries.en: Legal will not approve the pilot until both parties sign the master service-agreement.
entries.zh: 在双方签署主服务协议之前，法务不会批准试点。

entries.spelling: E, A, R, L, Y, hyphen, T, E, R, M, I, N, A, T, I, O, N
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，提前终止，提前解约，提前结束合同
entries.en: The lease allows early-termination after year two if the tenant pays three months’ rent.
entries.zh: 租约允许租户在第二年后提前终止，但须支付三个月租金。

entries.spelling: C, H, A, N, G, E, hyphen, R, E, Q, U, E, S, T
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，变更请求，变更申请，范围变更单
entries.en: Any new feature outside the statement of work requires a signed change-request.
entries.zh: 工作说明书范围以外的任何新功能都需要签署变更请求。

entries.spelling: P, U, R, C, H, A, S, E, hyphen, R, E, Q, U, I, S, I, T, I, O, N
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，采购申请，请购单，内部采购需求单
entries.en: IT cannot place the order until Finance clears the purchase-requisition in the system.
entries.zh: 在财务于系统中核准采购申请之前，IT 不能下单。

entries.spelling: T, R, A, V, E, L, hyphen, P, O, L, I, C, Y
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，差旅政策，出差规定，差旅报销制度
entries.en: Bookings above the travel-policy cap need director approval before ticketing.
entries.zh: 超出差旅政策上限的预订，出票前须获得总监批准。

entries.spelling: B, O, A, R, D, I, N, G, hyphen, G, R, O, U, P
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，登机组别，登机分区，登机优先组

entries.zh: 她的登机牌显示登机组别为 4，因此会在优先旅客之后登机。

entries.spelling: C, L, A, W, B, A, C, K
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，追回条款，回拨，已发款项的收回
entries.en: The bonus plan includes a clawback if earnings are later restated.
entries.zh: 奖金方案包含追回条款：若日后对收益进行重述，公司可收回奖金。

entries.spelling: R, I, N, G, hyphen, F, E, N, C, E
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，环围隔离，专项圈定（资金/资产），设隔离保护
entries.en: Regulators required the bank to ring-fence retail deposits from investment banking risks.
entries.zh: 监管机构要求该银行将零售存款与投资银行业务风险隔离。

entries.spelling: S, I, D, E, hyphen, L, E, T, T, E, R
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，附属函，补充协议函，合同旁函
entries.en: The investor rights were clarified in a side-letter rather than rewriting the main agreement.
entries.zh: 投资者权利在附属函中予以澄清，而不是重写主协议。

entries.spelling: E, X, C, L, U, S, I, V, I, T, Y
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，排他性，独家权，专营/专属期间
entries.en: During the exclusivity period, the seller may not solicit competing bids.
entries.zh: 在排他期内，卖方不得征求竞争性报价。

entries.spelling: L, E, T, T, E, R, hyphen, O, F, hyphen, I, N, T, E, N, T
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，意向书，合作意向函，初步意向文件
entries.en: Both parties signed a letter-of-intent outlining the proposed joint venture terms.
entries.zh: 双方签署了意向书，概述拟议合资条款。

entries.spelling: M, E, M, O, R, A, N, D, U, M, hyphen, O, F, hyphen, U, N, D, E, R, S, T, A, N, D, I, N, G
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，谅解备忘录，合作备忘录，MOU
entries.en: The universities signed a memorandum-of-understanding on student exchange programs.
entries.zh: 两所大学就学生交换项目签署了谅解备忘录。

entries.spelling: I, N, D, E, M, N, I, F, I, C, A, T, I, O, N
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，赔偿，补偿义务，弥偿安排
entries.en: The supplier agreed to indemnification for any third-party IP claims.
entries.zh: 供应商同意就任何第三方知识产权索赔提供赔偿。

entries.spelling: H, O, L, D, B, A, C, K
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，扣留款，暂扣金额，尾款扣留
entries.en: Ten percent of the contract price is held as a holdback until final inspection.
entries.zh: 合同价款的百分之十作为扣留款，待最终验收后再支付。

entries.spelling: R, E, T, A, I, N, A, G, E
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，工程质保金，保留金，施工尾款扣留
entries.en: The owner will release the remaining retainage after the warranty period ends.
entries.zh: 保修期结束后，业主将发还剩余的工程保留金。

entries.spelling: P, U, N, C, H, hyphen, L, I, S, T
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，整改清单，扫尾缺陷清单，竣工查验问题单
entries.en: Move-in is delayed until the contractor finishes every punch-list item.
entries.zh: 须等承包商完成整改清单上的每一项后，方可办理迁入。
